Name: 300 Slot backpack
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]300 Slot Backpack[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tired of running out of inventory space during long mining trips, fishing sessions, or farm runs? [b]300 Slot Backpack[/b] massively expands your inventory to [b]300 total slots[/b], giving you the freedom to carry far more items without constantly running back to your chests.
The mod uses a [b]clean, scrollable inventory interface[/b], allowing you to access your additional slots without overcrowding the screen. Your hotbar remains available while you scroll through the expanded storage area.
✨ Features[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]🎒 [b]300 total inventory slots[/b] [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]📜 [b]Scrollable inventory[/b] [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]🖱️ Mouse-wheel navigation [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]⬆️⬇️ Scroll buttons for easy navigation [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]⚡ Lightweight and focused on one purpose [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]🔧 Standalone SMAPI mod [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]📦 No complicated backpack upgrade system [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]🌾 Great for farming, mining, fishing, foraging, and exploration[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8]It's not compatible my 120 slot backpack or any other backpack mods[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Carry more. Make fewer trips. Spend more time playing.[/b][/color]
